value.Career: You do your calmest work closest to pressure, because the deadlines that grind other people turn into steady output in your hands.
value.Health: Comfort is what protects you, because good food and work with your hands turn pressure into something you can use.

TG_PATTERN.canonical_name: The Virtuoso harnessed by the Sage

value.Career: Your boldest ideas and your patience for study feed each other, and you grow braver in public with every qualification you earn.
value.Mind: You learn best when you can perform what you learn, and you turn every course you finish into something you can say out loud.
You also think so long about a thing that you miss the moment to make it, and you keep a drawer of nearly finished work.
value.Career: You also polish your work in private until the moment to show it has passed, and you lose more chances by not finishing than by failing.
value.Health: In your heaviest thinking seasons you also forget to eat and sleep properly, and your body tells you before your mind admits it.

value.Career: You keep correcting the very structures you climb, and you do your brightest work wherever the rules are loosest.
You come out of every hard stretch at work more senior than you went in, and the pattern grows stronger with age.
value.Growth: You grow most through the years that weigh on you, and you have left every heavy stretch more skilled than you entered it.
value.Mind: You turn pressure into understanding, and the hardest years of your life are the ones that taught you how to think.

value.Wealth: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people.
What you make turns into money more easily for you than for most, and you earn most from the work that feels like play.
value.Career: You are paid best for the work you would do unpaid, and you grow your income by making more rather than by climbing.
Your earnings keep turning into standing, and you rarely ask for the title your results have already earned.
value.Wealth: You turn money into position, and you feel richer when a gain comes with respect than when it comes alone.

value.Career: You find your mentors inside the structures you join, and your name gathers weight the slow and lasting way.
value.Mind: You learn best inside a frame, a school or a firm or a discipline, and you keep studying long after the course has ended.
